profile.headline: Software Developer II at Health Payment Systems, Inc.
profile.summary: I am pursuing a technological career where I can use the technological skills and passions that I've acquired with computers, socialize with people, and utilize my interpersonal communication skills, while also being able to to further the field of Information Systems and Information Technology.

positions.title: programmer analyst
positions.description:
•Used SQL, JAVA and Unix to manage databases and support logs to correct systematic irregularities.
•Updated and synchronized database information between FIS, clients, and banking entities.
•Optimized and developed code in Unix, SQL, and Java to fortify internal middleware incident handling.

positions.title: IT System Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities 
Connecting eCommerce systems for an LLC whose focus was online reselling of products. Miscellaneous projects involving synchronization and integration of systems. 
 
Accomplishments 
• Lowered the labor hours required to implement many processes using Microsoft Excel’s macros, VBA, VBScript, and QTP/UFT software.  
• Synchronized inventory across multiple channels (ChannelAdvisor, Amazon Seller Central, Corporate Website, Warehouses, and Solutions Central) 
• Found and corrected pricing/taxing discrepancies using Logic Block, QuickBooks Accounting, QuickBooks Online, and Tax websites. 
• Corrected and synchronized internal and external quantity/pricing information. 
• Streamlined, analyzed and explained internal processes to coworkers. 
 
Skills Used 
e-Commerce Applications/Websites: 
Amazon Seller Central, Channel Advisor, Logic Block, Sell Brite, QuickBooks Accounting, & QuickBooks Online. 
 
Software: 
Microsoft Excel functions & macros, Unified Functional Testing (UFT), & Notepad.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutoring math, primarily algebra to students in a one-on-one setting. Also was a supplemental instructor, for algebra and Computer Science I (Java), where I would tutor entire classes at once.

positions.title: Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked in the Quality Assurance dept. where I wrote, tested, and debugged programs to better the quality of user experiences using online databases and querying systems.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Management Information Systems, General / Computer Science minor
